image_description: A street scene featuring a horizontal traffic light assembly suspended from a curved metal mast arm. The primary subject is a vertical cluster of three signal heads (red, yellow, green) with black visors. A secondary traffic light is visible in the background on the left. The setting includes a paved road, a grassy median, trees, and commercial buildings under an overcast sky.
